content_of_post_to_comment: Things they didn't teach you in school Preposition derives from praepositio ("to place before"). The name is purely functional: it is the piece that must be placed "before" a noun or pronoun to establish its connection with the rest of the sentence - and mainly with the verb -, creating the necessary bridge for the meaning.
comment: Interesting that prepositions are defined by placement, yet meaning often depends on context. Perhaps language shows how relationships—not just objects—carry the real structure of thought.
